lines.label: Escalation to the index in force on the run date

lines.label: Soft costs
lines.note: 25% of hard cost

lines.label: Contingency
lines.note: 10% of hard cost

lines.label: Land
lines.note: nominal: the owner is a municipality, and this screen carries the land of a church, a society or a government at $0 on a long lease or a transfer (F3)

lines.label: Capital cost
lines.note: hard + soft + contingency + land

lines.label: Market rent
lines.note: CMHC October 2025, 8 units; some unit types priced at the CMHC all-units average: the table has no figure for them

lines.label: Rent-geared-to-income
lines.note: 30% of an income of 70% of the Housing Income Limit (Vancouver), the way BC Housing's call documents estimate it: $1,015 a month for one bedroom or less, $1,260 for two, $1,505 for three; an estimate, so enter the operator's own rent when there is one

lines.label: Deep-subsidy rent
lines.note: the income assistance shelter allowance, $500 a month for one bedroom or less and $695 for two; $769 for three, 30% of the deep-subsidy income limit; the 25 supportive homes at the shelter component of income assistance, taken out of the market tier

lines.label: Vacancy
lines.note: 3.7% of gross rent, the CMHC survey's rate

lines.label: Operating cost
lines.note: $6,500 per unit

lines.label: Replacement reserve
lines.note: $600 per unit

lines.label: Support staffing
lines.note: not entered: the 25 supportive housing homes run on staffing this screen does not estimate

lines.label: Net operating income
lines.note: gross rent less vacancy, operating cost, reserve and support staffing, before any operating subsidy

lines.label: Operating subsidy
lines.note: none entered

lines.label: Community Housing Fund grant
lines.note: $178,059 per unit × 110; illustrative, at the 2026-27 provisional rate; no intake is open, so no grant is committed or implied

lines.label: Equity
lines.note: none entered

lines.label: Supportable debt
lines.note: the largest loan the net operating income carries: the lender wants net income 1.10 times the loan payment (the debt coverage ratio), at 6.19% repaid over 40 years (the amortization), $381,265 a year in payments

lines.label: Funding
lines.note: grants + equity + supportable debt

lines.label: Gap
lines.note: capital cost less funding; a negative gap is headroom, and a gap above the 15% line (this tool's screening line, not a funder's rule) of the capital cost reads Needs more sources
